LESSON: RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sanskaars (Jains)
Topic 6.1: Religious Ceremonies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Religious Ceremonies
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do religious ceremonies influence one’s life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge
2. model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge” using a home/county example.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies” using a home/county example.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge
• Model 2: model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge
2. Practise: model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Religious Ceremonies.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do religious ceremonies influence one’s life?
2. What role does religious ceremonies play in society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge
• model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies
